_comment: Feature vetoes for Fabric mods on the NeoForge-patched game: mixins that apply cleanly but are semantically wrong there. Delivered as mod options (never by editing the user's config files). Checked on the device 2026-11-05. Rules with via=drop_injector remove one injector from a mixin class (the rest of the mixin stays), for injectors a NeoForge system already does.

rules.reason: Lithium's PoiTypes <clinit> copy detaches TYPE_BY_STATE from NeoForge's GameData.getBlockStatePointOfInterestTypeMap() (modded POI blocks would be lost)
Lithium's @Overwrite ServerChunkCache.getChunk drops NeoForge's ChunkHolder.currentlyLoading bypass (NeoForge build ships ChunkLoadTricksMixin instead)

NeoForge layered GUI stacks FOOD_LEVEL, VEHICLE_HEALTH, AIR_LEVEL on Gui.rightHeight; with food kept visible (alwaysRenderFood) mount health and air already sit above it, shifting again would double the offset
